summary: Ashford Hospitality Trust Inc filed an 8-K reporting the completed sale of the Sheraton Mission Valley in San Diego, CA via its subsidiary Ashford MV San Diego LP to Hotel Circle Holdings LLC for ~$45.3M in cash (subject to prorations), with net proceeds of ~$45.0M after expenses. The company also paid ~$35.9M to the mortgage lender securing the property plus 14 other hotels. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The sale closed on June 9, 2026, per the agreement dated March 26, 2026. The transaction appears to be a straightforward asset sale reducing leverage; watch for further dispositions as the lodging REIT continues deleveraging.
